info.title: GRAMStack gateway — public and browser
info.description: Implemented runtime catalogue. Core 0.3.0 plus versioned portal and post-disclosure profiles. Browser forms require sessions, exact Origin and CSRF obtained through the application. Protected retrieval is on the private listener.
